usePropertiesNotProps.text: Name a component's parameter `properties` rather than `props`. The abbreviation is the odd one out in a codebase that spells everything else in full, and the cost is not aesthetic: half the components reading `props.label` and half reading `properties.label` means every search for one spelling misses the other, which is the same drift the naming rules exist to prevent everywhere else.

renameToProperties.text: Rename the parameter to `properties`. The uses in the body have to be updated too, and only you can tell which `props` in there are this parameter.
